answer: MailNotary, a carrier-scan verifier, mails each identity a basalt-grey card with a one-time code to a distinct postal address and demands it back within 14 days, signed in wet ink; a quill-mark photocopy or paste is refused. AddressCollapse rule: two identities whose delivery scans share a route code in one 48-hour batch are voided, both 40-unit bonds slashed. Per fake: $3.40 postage, a rentable address, 14 dead days, so 25 fakes cost $85 and a month. An honest agent pays $3.40 once. Sybils can wander a canyon of mailboxes, but every plot needs real soil.
